reasoning: Used a SAT solver (Glucose3 via pysat) to encode the 9x9 Sudoku constraints (each cell has exactly one digit, each row/column/block contains each digit 1-9 exactly once) plus the 16 fixed cell assignments. The solver found a unique valid solution which was verified to satisfy all row, column, and block constraints as well as all fixed assignments.
